headline.en: Build your software factory, one module at a time.
headline.fr: Construisez votre software factory, un module à la fois.

introduction.en: Four independent modules. One integration framework. Start with what you need and keep control of what agents may do.
introduction.fr: Quatre modules indépendants. Un framework pour les assembler. Prenez ce dont vous avez besoin et gardez le contrôle des agents.

status_note.en: Scaffold, audit tooling and framework examples are available. The integrated SpaceShip cockpit is planned.
status_note.fr: Le socle, les outils d’audit et les exemples des frameworks sont disponibles. Le cockpit intégré SpaceShip reste à construire.

modules.name: Æion Factory

summary.en: Start coding with clear instructions, linked knowledge and checks.
summary.fr: Commencer à coder avec des consignes, une documentation liée au code et des vérifications.

available: Repository scaffold, development method, hooks and checks
planned_or_not_provided: No hosted service or mandatory integration
modules.license: MIT; upstream content retains its own license

quickstart.expected: Documentation check reports PASS. No model call is made.

modules.name: Æion OPS

summary.en: Define secure execution boundaries and maintain a pinned security-audit toolkit.
summary.fr: Définir les frontières de sécurité et maintenir un kit d’audit de sécurité versionné.

available: Complete pinned Cloudflare audit skill and offline integrity checker
modules.license: MIT; upstream content retains its own license

quickstart.expected: Reports integrity_verified and 22 verified files. This does not run an audit or qualify isolation.

modules.name: Æion CROA

summary.en: Assess evidence for a deterministic foundation using an attributed CROA audit kit.
summary.fr: Évaluer les preuves du socle déterministe avec un kit d’audit attribué au projet CROA.

available: Offline audit-packet init, validation and report CLI
Pinned CROA references and optional callable skill
planned_or_not_provided: Independent deployed-scope assessment; no automatic certification
modules.license: MIT code and CC BY 4.0 CROA-derived content

quickstart.expected: Prints an unassessed audit packet. It does not inspect a target or award conformance.

modules.name: Æion Observability

summary.en: Connect session telemetry to verified outcomes, cost and completion time.
summary.fr: Relier la télémétrie des sessions aux résultats vérifiés, aux coûts et au temps de réalisation.

planned_or_not_provided: Live collector, qualified adapters and routing controller
modules.license: MIT; upstream content retains its own license

quickstart.expected: Prints synthetic cohort costs and cost per autonomous success. This is not a benchmark.

modules.name: Æion SpaceShip

summary.en: Compose the modules into a software-factory framework with deterministic authority.
summary.fr: Assembler les modules en framework de software factory avec une autorité déterministe.

maturity_label.fr: Plan d’intégration et outils de catalogue

available: Modular ecosystem catalog and adoption guide
Architecture, contracts and staged implementation plan
planned_or_not_provided: Integrated cockpit, governed agent execution and delivery adapters
modules.license: MIT; upstream content retains its own license

quickstart.expected: Checks the module catalog, generated documentation, links and inactive fixtures. It does not start a cockpit.
